notes: «بإسناده رفعه إلى» is a gap, not a back reference: the text says «رفعه» (rule 8), so it is an unnamed link, and the Imam named after it is the last link
The Imam then acts and speaks inside a narrated scene («مر بالقصابين فنهاهم»): whether this is sourced or only in the scene is for a ruling (rule 11); the Imam is kept as written, not completed
«رضي الله عنه» and «عليه السلام» are left out; أبي is the compiler's own father, a bare relation
